description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Controller::Root' package, a Catalyst controller handling various web actions such as index, about, dashboard, and common setup routines like begin and end. It manages request preprocessing, URL generation, access control, and rendering logic for the web application.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Root
classes.description: Controller class for handling root-level web actions and request setup in the Coocook web application.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Prepares request context, sets up URL and static resource paths, manages user session and permissions, and initializes view variables.

methods.name: auto
methods.description: Per-request setup, primarily passing user info into stash.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the root URL, fetching recipes of the day and redirecting based on user capabilities.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Enforces HTTPS redirection unless in debug mode or on localhost, setting up request context.

methods.name: homepage
methods.description: Prepares data for the homepage, including recipes and projects.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Prepares user-specific project data for the dashboard view.

methods.name: about
methods.description: Sets the page title for the about page.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes response, handles access control for submenu items, encodes JSON data, and sets security headers.

methods.name: _validated_redirect
methods.description: Validates and performs a redirect based on a URL parameter, ensuring security.
